name: 10pines-c2-visitor-rule
title: Visitor implementation rule (metaprogramming)
description: A VisitorRule object that verifies by reflection that a class hierarchy and a visitor class follow the course's Visitor convention (abstract accept: in the root, each concrete subclass X sending visitX: self, the visitor understanding every visitX:), signaling descriptive errors; the 6 given tests fix the API and the error messages. Only the solution file exists for Cuis, so a starting point would have to be derived from it.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C2 - Diseño Avanzado de Software con Objetos II

design.notes: Metaprogramming rather than domain design: reading the structure (compiledMethodAt:, isAbstract, canUnderstand:, allSubclasses) and observing behaviour by sending accept: to a basicNew instance with a ProtoObject message eater that records what accept: sends; the naming convention visitX: is computed from class names.
